## Load libraries

```{r}
#| message: false
library("tidyverse")
```

## Load data

```{r}

# Create _raw and data folder
raw_data_path <- "../_raw/"
data_path <- "../data/"

if (!dir.exists(raw_data_path)) {
  dir.create(raw_data_path)
}
if (!dir.exists(data_path)) {
  dir.create(data_path)
}

base_url <- "https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/series/GSE311nnn/GSE311689/suppl/"

# ASV table
asv_raw <- read_tsv(file = str_c(base_url, "GSE311689_ASV_table.tsv.gz"), show_col_types = FALSE)
write_tsv(x = asv_raw,
          file = str_c(raw_data_path, "GSE311689_ASV_table.tsv"))
write_tsv(x = asv_raw,
          file = str_c(data_path, "01_dat_load_asv.tsv"))

# Sample metadata
meta_raw <- read_tsv(file = str_c(base_url, "GSE311689_sample_metadata.tsv.gz"), show_col_types = FALSE)
write_tsv(x = meta_raw,
          file = str_c(raw_data_path, "GSE311689_sample_metadata.tsv"))
write_tsv(x = meta_raw,
          file = str_c(data_path, "01_dat_load_meta.tsv"))

# Taxonomy table
tax_raw <- read_tsv(file = str_c(base_url, "GSE311689_taxonomy_table.tsv.gz"), show_col_types = FALSE)
write_tsv(x = tax_raw,
          file = str_c(raw_data_path, "GSE311689_taxonomy_table.tsv"))
write_tsv(x = tax_raw,
          file = str_c(data_path, "01_dat_load_tax.tsv"))
```
